gravity_method: minus mean accelerometer over the take's stillest 1 s window (sliding 0.25 s steps, ranked by median bias-removed gyro magnitude); rotated into each pair-start frame with the gyro-chained rotation from the window start
frame_convention: T_depth = X^-1 T_imu X with X = [I | imu_to_depth]; axes taken as aligned (no rotation given); R unchanged, t -> t + t_imu - R t_imu
